segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Namaste Suresh ji, aaj boxes ke rate aur delivery pe baat final karni hai.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Namaste madam. Haan, maine pichhle hafte jo quote bheja tha woh aapne dekha?

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Dekha, aapne 5-ply box ka 21 rupaye per piece bola hai. Ye bahut zyada hai.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Madam kraft paper ka rate badh gaya hai, पिछले महीने से बारह प्रतिशत ऊपर है।

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Woh samajh rahe hain, par hum quantity bhi double kar rahe hain, bees hazaar boxes.

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Doosre supplier ne 17 bola hai, bas unki quality pe bharosa nahi hai.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Sattrah mein toh main 3-ply hi de paunga, 5-ply nahi.

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Toh beech ka rasta nikalte hain. 18 rupaye pe aap ready ho?

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Bees hazaar ka order pakka hai toh 18 chal jayega, par payment thirty days mein chahiye.

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Thirty days theek hai, hamara standard bhi wahi hai.

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Theek hai, toh final: bees hazaar 5-ply boxes, 18 rupaye per box.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Done madam, मैं आज ही PO के लिए proforma भेज दूँगा।

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Ek baat aur, poore bees hazaar ek saath rakhne ki jagah nahi hai hamare paas.

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Haan, delivery do lot mein chahiye. Das hazaar abhi, das hazaar November ke end mein.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: दो lot में कोई problem नहीं, बस दूसरी lot की date पहले बता देना।

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Toh woh bhi final, delivery do lot mein hogi, das das hazaar.

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Pehli lot ke liye bhi godown mein jagah banani padegi, abhi wahan purana stock pada hai.

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Haan, godown mein jagah kisi ko dekhna padega, main toh is hafte travel pe hoon.

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Mere paas bhi audit hai. Dekhte hain, koi na koi godown khaali karwa dega.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Madam, ek suggestion hai. Aap log biodegradable tape pe shift kar lo, aajkal sab maang rahe hain.

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Uska rate kya hai?

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Normal tape se lagbhag dedh guna.

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Abhi nahi Suresh ji, pehle boxes settle karte hain. Tape wala idea abhi chhodo.

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Haan, tape ka budget abhi bilkul nahi hai.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Theek hai, jaise aap kaho.

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Naye boxes ka ek sample chahiye, print ke saath, taaki hum drop test kar sakein.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: नमूना मैं भेज दूँगा, logo printing के साथ।

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Suresh ji, sample kab tak aa jayega?

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Agle Friday tak sample aapke office pahunch jayega.

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Agle Friday theek hai. Waise humari GST filing 20 October ko hai, us hafte main busy rahunga.

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Koi baat nahi, sample main receive kar lungi, GST alag cheez hai.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Aman ji, logo ka vector file chahiye hoga, PDF se print kharab aata hai.

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Main aaj shaam vector file mail kar deta hoon.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Aur box ke andar ka partition chahiye ya nahi?

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Partition sirf glass bottles wale box mein, baaki mein nahi.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Theek, partition wale kitne honge?

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Lagbhag do hazaar, woh hum PO mein alag line item daal denge.

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Pichhli baar kuch boxes geele aaye the, transport mein tarpaulin nahi tha.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Haan woh galti hui thi, is baar covered tempo bhejunga.

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Achha. Aur invoice pe HSN code sahi likhna, pichhli baar accounts ne wapas bheja tha.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: जी madam, इस बार ध्यान रखूँगा।

segments.speaker: Aman Khurana
segments.text: Mujhe lagta hai sab cover ho gaya. Neha, kuch reh gaya?

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Nahi, bas proforma aur sample ka wait karenge.

segments.speaker: Suresh Patil
segments.text: Dhanyavaad madam, dhanyavaad Aman ji.

segments.speaker: Neha Bhatt
segments.text: Thank you Suresh ji, milte hain.

decisions.fact: Twenty thousand 5-ply boxes are ordered at Rs 18 per box.
Delivery comes in two lots of ten thousand each.

action_items.fact: Suresh sends a printed sample of the new box for a drop test.
Space in the godown is cleared for the first lot; nobody named.
Aman mails the logo vector file to the vendor today.

distractors.fact: Switching to biodegradable tape was suggested and dropped.
20 October is the GST filing, not the sample's due date.
